cross_verification_standard: ≥4 corroborating references for CONFIRMED/LEAKED; first-party GSC data is the tie-breaker and overrides generic advice.

claims.claim: CTR on a query–URL pair is a direct ranking input (NavBoost / clickSignals).
claims.actionable_signal: title/meta quality; high impressions + low CTR = risk

claims.claim: Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP/CLS) are a confirmed ranking signal.
claims.action: fix pages failing all three on mobile

claims.claim: Original/unique content scores higher; thin/duplicate scores low (OriginalContentScore).
claims.action: add proprietary data, case studies, original media
claims.data_status: PARTIAL (content auditable now; ranking effect needs GSC)

claims.claim: Site-level authority exists and gates new domains (siteAuthority + 6–12mo sandbox).
claims.action: new sites build links + brand mentions from launch; expect 6–12mo ramp

claims.claim: E-E-A-T shapes quality-rater scores that train ranking systems (esp. YMYL).
claims.action: author schema + credentials + last-reviewed dates on YMYL pages
publish fast for trend queries; meaningfully update evergreen + set dateModified

claims.claim: GBP completeness + review signals drive local-pack ranking.
claims.action: delegated to existing google-business-profile + local-seo-agent skills

claims.claim: AI Overview citations favour concise direct answers + structure + schema + authority.
claims.action: above-the-fold direct answer + FAQPage/HowTo schema + short declarative sentences
claims.validation: manual AI-Overview citation checks + GEO visibility score (math model §8)

claims.claim: GEO/AEO/AEI as a discipline is real but most specific tactics are unproven.
claims.action: every GEO tactic enters the backlog as HYPOTHESIS_FOR_TESTING
claims.validation: single-variable A/B with explicit kill threshold

excluded_claims: Specific numeric ranking-factor weights — Google does not publish these.
Any traffic/CTR/volume figure for a portfolio site — DATA_REQUIRED (live GSC).
Any Neil Patel / YouTube claim — no data ingested; would be OPINION_SOURCE (0.1).
